problem: All tests panic in Candidate::value_at from an overflow after the initial Li Chao implementation.

hyp_01a02999741172e1b4f38c7b27b06e03.statement: The Li Chao tree receives unreachable u128::MAX sentinel DP states during group one; filtering them fixes the overflow without changing the recurrence.

evidence.claim: Filtering unreachable u128::MAX predecessor states removed the observed overflow; debug and release suites pass all oracle, zero-prefix, large-value, and 80,000×80 tests.

hyp_01a02999741172e1b4f38c88197e4062.statement: The candidate cost expression needs saturating arithmetic because reachable costs can overflow under the task bounds.
